messages:
sam_sales: Hey team — FinEdge POC is blocked. Their Python client (our sdk v0.4.2) is streaming but hitting intermittent 429s and proxy 504s. They say the SDK ignores Retry-After and retries immediately which amplifies the rate limit. Also asked if switching to Dedicated reserved avoids this. Can we swarm?

mia_eng: Can you paste a short log excerpt and the exact client config?

sam_sales: log snippet: `2026-03-12T14:02:11Z INFO request_id=req_8a2b 429 Retry-After: 30` then immediately `2026-03-12T14:02:11Z INFO retry attempt=1 request_id=req_8a2b` — so retrying right away.

alex_devex: Probable cause: older SDK ignores Retry-After with streaming path. Quick repro: run curl with proxy to simulate burst: 
```bash
HTTP_PROXY=http://corp-proxy:3128 
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream
```

sanjay_oncall: We also saw x-rd-limit headers in the platform logs: `x-rd-rl: bucket=streaming; remaining=0; reset=30`. If client ignores Retry-After it creates a thundering herd.

sam_sales: Customer environment: on-prem app servers behind Squid 4.8 proxy (mutual TLS passthrough). They reported a couple 504s too when proxy dropped longer-lived streams.

mia_eng: Steps: 1) verify SDK honors Retry-After for streaming endpoints, 2) add jittered backoff and max-concurrent-streams limit, 3) test with proxy charlie (we have a repro proxy). I'll try a patch.

alex_devex: For immediate mitigation, tell customer to set env var `RW_SDK_RESPECT_RETRY_AFTER=true` and configure client: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(token=..., respect_retry_after=True, backoff={"strategy":"jittered_exponential","max_retries":5}, stream_concurrency=2)
```

kelly_cs: Also they're asking pricing/SLA: if they move to Dedicated reserved, will rate limits still apply? They want guaranteed throughput for POC scale.

ben_platform: Dedicated gives isolated GPU pools and much higher soft limits; concrete answer: reserved removes noisy-tenant contention for capacity but platform-level rate limit headers still exist to protect individual routes. We can increase per-customer rate quotas for a Dedicated contract — needs sales/ops approval.

sam_sales: Noted. I'll flag with account exec. For the POC we need a short-term fix.

devops-bot: deploy-1234 to staging succeeded (mia/patch/respect-retry-after) — 2 containers updated.

mia_eng: Patch pushed to staging that respects Retry-After on stream errors and adds jitter. I ran a local replay behind our repro proxy and saw no immediate retries for 30s.

sanjay_oncall: Can you share the new client config + logs from staging? Also add a metric export for `sdk.retry_after_respected` so we can see adoption.

mia_eng: log from staging: `2026-03-12T18:04:02Z INFO request_id=req_b3c Retry-After=30 honored; next_attempt=2026-03-12T18:04:32Z` 
metrics: `sdk.retry_after_respected: 28` in the last hour.

sam_sales: Customer tried the env var and saw immediate improvement — streaming stable, 504s reduced. They want an official patch in next release and a note on docs. Also asked can we temporarily bump their quota for the POC (3 days).

ben_platform: I'll open an ops ticket for a temporary quota bump and copy legal/sales for contract implications.

kelly_cs: I'll confirm POC timeline and whether Finance needs a quote for Dedicated pricing if they pursue.

alex_devex: Follow-up action: include sample config in docs, highlight `respect_retry_after` and `stream_concurrency`, and add a KB entry for corp proxies (squid/bluecoat) with recommended timeouts.

sam_sales: Thanks all. I'll update FinEdge and loop in account exec + legal once we have the ops ticket.

mia_eng: I'll prep a small patch release (v0.4.3) with the fix and a short changelog entry.

sam_sales: Awesome. Close loop when v0.4.3 published and quota bump done. :thumbsup:
